name: Soul of the Wizard
body:
Associated Skills: Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (planes), Spellcraft, Use Magic Device

Associated Veils: Bands of the Void, Gloves of Repulsion, Mobius Ribbon, Pooling Black, Robe of the Forgotten Deity, Runecloth of Doorways, Shackles of Perdition, Shawl of Shifting Stars

Familiar

At 1st level, tapping into the soul of the wizard allows you to call upon a familiar to aid you. This familiar is created when you forge this soul, and you can change its shape each time you do so, or when you shape your veils for the day. You cannot apply familiar archetypes to this familiar. You treat your soulforge level as your wizard level when determining your familiar’s abilities. If your familiar is slain, it is returned to life the next time you shape your veils, if you have not forged a new soul. When you forge a new soul, you lose your familiar. If you forge multiple souls that grant you a familiar, you only gain one familiar. If the familiar is modified by your souls, it receives all of the modifications as long as they do not conflict.

Arcane School

At 3rd level, the soul of the wizard grants you the knowledge and powers of an arcane school. Each time you forge this soul, select an arcane school available to the wizard: you gain the abilities of that arcane school granted to a wizard at 1st level. At 11th level, you gain the 8th level ability as well. Use your soulforge level as your wizard level and your Wisdom in place of your Intelligence when determining the effects of those abilities.

Deliver Veils

At 3rd level, the soul of the wizard grants you greater command over the magical powers of your familiar, allowing it to deliver the effects of your veils. Whenever you use an ability of a veil that can be delivered with a touch or a melee touch attack, you can store its effects within your familiar. During your familiar’s turn, it can deliver that veil effect just as you could have (making a melee touch attack using its own statistics, if necessary) as a standard action. You must be in physical contact with your familiar when you use the veil effect to store it within your familiar. The veil effect remains stored within your familiar until it chooses to discharge it, until you activate another veil effect that costs a non-free action, or you cast a spell or use a spell-like ability.

Magic Item Initiate (Su)

At 5th level, your attunement to the wizard’s soul grants you an aptitude when using magical objects. You gain the effects of the read magic spell as a constant effect, and may use your Wisdom in place of your Charisma with the Use Magic Device skill. When using wands, scrolls, and staves you may use your soulforge level in place of the item’s caster level, and your Wisdom modifier in place of the item’s spellcasting modifier.
